about: Stella layer evaluation (Task 10 of the memory plan), kept apart from questions.json so the 13 Nov baseline stays comparable. Each question names the deepest memory layer a good answer needs (header < vault < summaries < transcripts) and, when it asks about recent calls, within_days. Required facts: every inner list is a set of alternatives, at least one must appear (case-insensitive). Facts were taken only from stored data on 18 Nov 2026: call summaries and transcript passages of World Emblem's digested calls (2 to 18 Nov), transcript_accounts headlines (the header digest) and vault files. Entries with todo: true are placeholders, skipped by scripts/eval.mjs until their project's calls are synced and digested. Each question carries asOf, the date its facts were checked against stored data. Header questions depend on the 10-line digest of the last 30 days, so they drift as new calls arrive: re-check them before each run.
